Title: Public Preview: Data mapping designer in Azure Logic Apps (Standard)

Body.Content:
Microsoft has re-envisioned data transformations in Azure Logic Apps (Standard) by building a new data mapper experience from the ground up. This visual designer supports XML and JSON data transformations in a modern drag-and-drop experience from within VS Code. 

This new experience supports the following scenarios: 

Bring in your existing XML and JSON schemas and build data transformations across these different formats.  

Leverage reusable functions, including string and date manipulation, calculations to increase developer productivity. 

Explore the code view of your data transformations for additional perspectives on the data transformation. 

Take advantage of the built-in testing feature to test maps before you deploy them. 

Learn more about this update.
